# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster of Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache which he frequently curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips is a sarcastic, stern, and impatient teacher who carries out his discipline with a high hand and a sarcastic inflection. He is prone to spasmodic fits of reform, though his energy in enforcing order is generally slack and inconsistent. He neglects his younger pupils to devote his time to older ones, particularly courting one of his senior students during school hours.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- Stern and impatient  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P63](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0063)</sub>
- Neglectful of younger students  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching Latin, algebra, and other advanced subjects  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Reciting poetry and orations  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Preparing his advanced students for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Courting Prissy Andrews  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school, where he focused most of his attention on preparing older pupils like Prissy Andrews for the entrance exams to Queen's Academy. During school hours, he openly courted Prissy Andrews and sat by her desk to explain lessons or write notes. When Gilbert Blythe teased Anne Shirley about her hair, prompting Anne to crack her slate over Gilbert's head, Mr. Phillips punished Anne by making her stand in front of the blackboard with a message proclaiming her bad temper. The following day, after several pupils arrived late from the woods, Mr. Phillips singled out Anne as a scapegoat and forced her to sit next to Gilbert Blythe for the afternoon, causing Anne to quit school for a time. He also took part in the Avonlea Debating Club's grand concert, reciting Mark Antony's oration over Caesar. At the end of the school year, he gave a farewell speech to his pupils before leaving Avonlea for good.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c15 P77](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0077), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Secured his teaching position through his uncle, who is a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Boarded at Eben Wright's house during his time as Avonlea's schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>

## Quotes

> Ann Shirley has a very bad temper. Ann Shirley must learn to control her temper.  <sub>[v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046)</sub>

> The time has come for us to part.  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
